parsed.restated: ∀ {δ : ℝ}, 0 < δ → δ < (1 : ℝ) / 2 → Filter.limsup (fun n : ℕ => Real.logb 2 ((MetricCodes.Hamming.codeNumber n (Nat.ceil (δ * (n : ℝ))) : ℕ) : ℝ) / (n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop < MetricCodes.binaryEntropy ((1 : ℝ) / 2 - Real.sqrt (δ * (1 - δ)))
parsed.english: For every δ with 0 < δ < 1/2, the limsup of (log₂ A(n, ⌈δn⌉))/n is strictly less than H₂(1/2 − √(δ(1−δ))), where A(n,d) is the maximum size of a binary code of length n and minimum distance d, and H₂ is the binary entropy function. The right-hand side is the classical rate (the first-order MRRW bound).
parsed.why_clearer: It unfolds binaryRate, classicalRate and classicalParameter into the explicit limsup of log₂ A(n, ⌈δn⌉)/n compared with H₂(1/2 − √(δ(1−δ))), and it binds δ with an explicit quantifier, which the earlier attempts left unbound.
